texts.en:
A drone on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] has managed to get their [from.target.species.GetHandNamePlural] on one of our measuring devices. It has already started to take our device apart; it's only a matter of time before the understanding spreads to the local hive.

We must act quickly if we wish to avoid interfering with their natural development.

label.zh: 让这些子个体拨弄我们的废品。
label.en: Let the drones pick at our scraps.

label.zh: 要是我们将装置启动会怎么样？
label.en: What if we were to turn it on?

label.zh: 遥控引爆当地所有的渗透设备。
label.en: Remotely detonate all the local infiltration equipment.
